default.$description: Default padding for primary cards and panels.

compact.$description: Tight vertical spacing between related items.

sm.$description: Small horizontal spacing used in chip contexts.
Small geometry scalar (= 0.5rem); seeds the size.spacing contract.

md.$description: Medium geometry scalar (= 0.875rem); seeds the size.spacing contract.

lg.$description: Large geometry scalar (= 1.25rem); continues the +0.375rem scale ramp (sm 8 / md 14 / lg 20). Completes the t-shirt set so emitter md/sm/lg all resolve (sprint-125 m03).

050.$description: Component geometry ramp 050: 0.125rem (2px at the 16px root). 100 is the 4px unit; every sys component geometry role resolves to one ramp entry (Sprint 200 m02).

100.$description: Component geometry ramp 100: 0.25rem (4px at the 16px root). 100 is the 4px unit; every sys component geometry role resolves to one ramp entry (Sprint 200 m02).

150.$description: Component geometry ramp 150: 0.375rem (6px at the 16px root). 100 is the 4px unit; every sys component geometry role resolves to one ramp entry (Sprint 200 m02).

200.$description: Component geometry ramp 200: 0.5rem (8px at the 16px root). 100 is the 4px unit; every sys component geometry role resolves to one ramp entry (Sprint 200 m02). Equals ref.space.scale.sm.

250.$description: Component geometry ramp 250: 0.625rem (10px at the 16px root). 100 is the 4px unit; every sys component geometry role resolves to one ramp entry (Sprint 200 m02).

300.$description: Component geometry ramp 300: 0.75rem (12px at the 16px root). 100 is the 4px unit; every sys component geometry role resolves to one ramp entry (Sprint 200 m02). Equals ref.space.stack.compact.

400.$description: Component geometry ramp 400: 1rem (16px at the 16px root). 100 is the 4px unit; every sys component geometry role resolves to one ramp entry (Sprint 200 m02).

500.$description: Component geometry ramp 500: 1.25rem (20px at the 16px root). 100 is the 4px unit; every sys component geometry role resolves to one ramp entry (Sprint 200 m02). Equals ref.space.scale.lg.

600.$description: Component geometry ramp 600: 1.5rem (24px at the 16px root). 100 is the 4px unit; every sys component geometry role resolves to one ramp entry (Sprint 200 m02). Equals ref.space.inset.default.

800.$description: Component geometry ramp 800: 2rem (32px at the 16px root). 100 is the 4px unit; every sys component geometry role resolves to one ramp entry (Sprint 200 m02).

1000.$description: Component geometry ramp 1000: 2.5rem (40px at the 16px root). 100 is the 4px unit; every sys component geometry role resolves to one ramp entry (Sprint 200 m02).

1200.$description: Component geometry ramp 1200: 3rem (48px at the 16px root). 100 is the 4px unit; every sys component geometry role resolves to one ramp entry (Sprint 200 m02).
